scientific_question: How many task-selected singular directions and explicit factor-state degrees of freedom are required to represent the dense c_proj action left outside the production-sized chart?

theory.geometric_scope: The working c_proj procedure is an adaptive scaled right-orthogonal flow. Dense c_proj motion also changes the row Gram matrix W W^T, so a learned-basis or LoRA-like repair must carry the high-rank residual that the right-orbit chart cannot represent.
theory.oracle_definition: For every accepted layer-phase residual R, eig(R R^T) gives the exact best rank-r Frobenius recovery. Singular vectors are selected from R itself, making this an optimistic noncausal capacity bound.
theory.state_accounting: A rank-r matrix has intrinsic dimension r(m+n-r); a practical two-factor parameterization stores r(m+n) scalars. Both are compared with the existing 147456 procedural coordinates and the 2359296-element c_proj matrix.
theory.causal_caveat: Matrix rank is not a lower bound on arbitrary nonlinear generator dimension. It is a lower bound only for explicit task-selected low-rank/factor/basis state, and therefore cannot authorize training by itself.
theory.why_not_another_training_arm: Trace-free output shear over-concentrated the spectrum, scalar log-volume was causally harmful, and a bounded layer-0 full symmetric action recovered only 62-63 percent of dense task gain. This analysis measures the required state before any further structural guess.

interpretation.equal_budget_pass: An explicit equal-budget low-rank state remains capacity-plausible; authorize theory only, not implementation.
interpretation.quarter_dense_pass_only: At least a materially larger explicit factor state is required; quantify it but do not implement.
interpretation.both_fail: An explicit task-conditioned low-rank/basis state is already dense-scale; retain only task-conditioned procedural-selector theory.

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable because this analysis performs zero model or optimizer updates
